mechanism: co-expressing Gbeta5 with Stim1 and Orai1 in HEK293T cells raised SOCE about 2.5-fold; the dominant-negative DeltaERM-Stim1 D76A abolished the enhancement, whereas a loss-of-function Orai1 mutant did not, so the effect needs the STIM1 ERM region and not a conducting channel
sentence: With Gbeta5 expression, the SOCE was approximately 2.5- fold higher than that with Stim1 or Orai1 expression.
justification: A heterotrimeric G-protein subunit acting on the sensor rather than on the channel, with the mutant dissection showing which side it needs. GNB5 mutations cause bradycardia and cognitive disability in humans, so this is a named disease gene one hop from STIM1.

mechanism: mitochondrial depolarization impairs STIM1 trafficking to ER-PM junctions and the subsequent CRAC current; mitofusin 2, whose mutations cause Charcot-Marie-Tooth IIa, is identified as an important component of that mechanism, so a mitochondrial fusion protein gates protein movement inside the ER
sentence: Mitofusin 2 regulates STIM1 migration from the Ca2+ store to the plasma membrane in cells with depolarized mitochondria.
justification: The map has STIM1 reaching mitochondria (PMID 23076152, batch 14: shape, bioenergetics, NRF2); this is the return path, mitochondrial state setting whether the sensor can reach the junction at all. It also gives the map a second neurodegeneration gene upstream of an anchor.

mechanism: RNAi in HaCaT keratinocytes: knocking down STIM1 or Orai1 suppressed SOCE, abolished the Ca2+-switch response and left keratin 1 induction impaired, while also blocking the growth arrest that normally follows the Ca2+ switch
sentence: Knockdown of either STIM1 or Orai1 strongly suppressed SOCE and almost completely abolished the Ca(2+)-switch-induced Ca(2+) responses, resulting in impaired expression of keratin1, an early KC differentiation marker.
justification: A differentiation programme downstream of the anchors in epidermis, where the extracellular Ca2+ gradient is the physiological signal. KRT1 is a concrete, named output rather than a phenotype.

mechanism: same knockdown experiments; either anchor is sufficient to abolish the differentiation response
sentence: Knockdown of either STIM1 or Orai1 strongly suppressed SOCE and almost completely abolished the Ca(2+)-switch-induced Ca(2+) responses, resulting in impaired expression of keratin1, an early KC differentiation marker.
justification: The channel side of the keratinocyte differentiation arm.

mechanism: co-immunoprecipitation from MDA-MB-231 and MCF7 lysates; the interaction is constitutive and unchanged by thapsigargin-induced store depletion, but the pore-dead TRPC6 mutant loses it, so cation influx through TRPC6 is needed for the contact itself
sentence: Finally, we have found that TRPC6 interacts with Orai1 and Orai3 in MCF7 and MDA-MB-231 cells and is required for the translocation of Orai1 and Orai3 to the plasma membrane in MDA-MB-231 and MCF7 cells, respectively, upon Ca2+ store depletion.
justification: TRPC6 is one of the curator's rows. The map had STIM1 -> TRPC6 (gating and abundance, batches 14-15); this is the other side, TRPC6 physically on ORAI1, and it explains why SOCE depends on a channel that is not itself carrying most of the current.

mechanism: same co-immunoprecipitations; in MCF7 cells TRPC6 binds Orai3 preferentially and in MDA-MB-231 cells Orai1, matching which Orai isoform carries SOCE in each line
sentence: Finally, we have found that TRPC6 interacts with Orai1 and Orai3 in MCF7 and MDA-MB-231 cells and is required for the translocation of Orai1 and Orai3 to the plasma membrane in MDA-MB-231 and MCF7 cells, respectively, upon Ca2+ store depletion.
justification: The partner swaps with the cell type, which is the same context-dependence the NOTCH1 records of batch 15 showed on the same two cell lines.

mechanism: silencing TRPC6 reduced the surface exposure of Orai1 in MDA-MB-231 cells without changing total Orai1 protein, and attenuated SOCE to the same extent reported for Orai1 knockdown
sentence: Finally, we have found that TRPC6 interacts with Orai1 and Orai3 in MCF7 and MDA-MB-231 cells and is required for the translocation of Orai1 and Orai3 to the plasma membrane in MDA-MB-231 and MCF7 cells, respectively, upon Ca2+ store depletion.
justification: A second trafficking edge onto ORAI1 beside DLG1 (batch 15), and the one that explains the functional dependence: no TRPC6, no channel at the membrane.

mechanism: same surface-biotinylation experiments in MCF7 cells, where Orai3 rather than Orai1 is the SOCE channel
sentence: Finally, we have found that TRPC6 interacts with Orai1 and Orai3 in MCF7 and MDA-MB-231 cells and is required for the translocation of Orai1 and Orai3 to the plasma membrane in MDA-MB-231 and MCF7 cells, respectively, upon Ca2+ store depletion.
justification: Completes the pair, and keeps ORAI3 as an actor in its own right rather than a footnote to ORAI1.

mechanism: RNAi in rat RBL-2H3 mast cells: Ca2+ and Sr2+ influx and degranulation all require TRPC5 in addition to STIM1 and Orai1; overexpressing STIM1 with Orai1 admits Ca2+ but not Sr2+, while STIM1 with TRPC5 admits both, which is how the authors infer a stoichiometric complex
sentence: These and other observations suggest that the Sr(2+)-permeable TRPC5 associates with STIM1 and Orai1 in a stoichiometric manner to enhance entry of Ca(2+) to generate a signal for degranulation.
justification: The map had ORAI1 -> TRPC5 activation (PMID 19815560, batch 12); this adds the contact and brings STIM1 into the same complex, with ion selectivity (Sr2+ permeation) as the argument that TRPC5 contributes its own pore.

mechanism: same knockdown and overexpression series; the divalent selectivity of the combined entry is what distinguishes the TRPC5-containing complex from ORAI1 alone
sentence: These and other observations suggest that the Sr(2+)-permeable TRPC5 associates with STIM1 and Orai1 in a stoichiometric manner to enhance entry of Ca(2+) to generate a signal for degranulation.
justification: The channel-channel half of the complex, which the map now also holds for TRPC1 (PMC10025536) and TRPC6 (above).

mechanism: co-immunoprecipitation and confocal co-localization of overexpressed PAK1 and STIM1 after thapsigargin; the authors note PAK1 may also phosphorylate STIM1, as ERK1 does, and relate the complex to nascent adhesion formation
sentence: Based on these findings, we propose that PAK1 interacts with STIM1 to regulate calcium mobilization and the formation of cellular adhesions.
justification: PAK1 is one of the curator's rows and had no literature edge. It is also the kinase "PAK" that review sentences keep citing as a STIM1 regulator without an isoform; here the isoform is named.

mechanism: chemical inhibitors (1,4-NHQ, PF3758309) and stable PAK1 knock-down both lowered STIM1-mediated Ca2+ mobilization, and the level of mobilization tracked PAK1 activity in cells transfected with active or inactive PAK1
sentence: Downregulation of PAK1 activity via chemical inhibitors or by PAK1 shDNA expression impaired STIM1-mediated calcium mobilization via SOCE.
justification: The sign of the PAK1 edge, from two independent manipulations. It matters because PRKCB, recorded in batch 15, pushes STIM1 the other way - the map now shows the sensor under opposing kinases.

mechanism: ectopic STIM1, or STIM1 with Orai1, doubled phospho-Y416 Src in WM793 melanoma cells without changing total Src; STIM1 shRNA, EGTA or 2-APB each lowered it, so basal Src activity depends on SOCE-driven Ca2+ oscillations
sentence: Calcium signaling mediated by STIM1 and Orai1 activates Src to promote invadopodium assembly while simultaneously promoting MT1-MMP recycling to the plasma membrane to promote ECM degradation.
justification: SRC is one of the curator's rows. This is the anchors acting on it, and it pairs with PMID 28866365 in the same batch, which puts STIM1 *downstream* of Src-Raf-MEK-ERK - a feedback loop rather than a contradiction, and the map can now show both arrows.

mechanism: same experiments; Orai1 shRNA lowered the Ca2+ oscillation frequency and invadopodial precursor number along with Src activity
sentence: Calcium signaling mediated by STIM1 and Orai1 activates Src to promote invadopodium assembly while simultaneously promoting MT1-MMP recycling to the plasma membrane to promote ECM degradation.
justification: The channel side of the SRC edge.

mechanism: blocking SOCE with 2-APB or knocking down STIM1 and Orai1 trapped MT1-MMP in Rab5-positive endosomes and reduced its plasma membrane pool, with no change in total MT1-MMP protein and only a modest effect on secreted MMP2
sentence: Calcium signaling mediated by STIM1 and Orai1 activates Src to promote invadopodium assembly while simultaneously promoting MT1-MMP recycling to the plasma membrane to promote ECM degradation.
justification: A protease delivered rather than transcribed: the anchors control where MT1-MMP is, not how much of it there is. The map's other MMP link (MMP14 mRNA under STIM2, PMC10592933) is transcriptional, so the two are complementary.

mechanism: same endosomal entrapment experiments
sentence: Calcium signaling mediated by STIM1 and Orai1 activates Src to promote invadopodium assembly while simultaneously promoting MT1-MMP recycling to the plasma membrane to promote ECM degradation.
justification: The channel side of the MT1-MMP trafficking arm, which is what makes individual invadopodia proteolytic.

mechanism: CRISPR/Cas9 STIM1-knockout PC3 cells still activate ERK1/2 fully, with or without extracellular Ca2+, so SOCE is not required upstream; the activation is sensitive to Src inhibition but not to CaMKII or PKC inhibition, which places STIM1 - phosphorylated at ERK1/2 target sites - downstream of Src-Raf-MEK-ERK
sentence: This activation was sensitive to Src kinase inhibition, but not to CAMKII nor PKC inhibition, a result that sets STIM1 and SOCE as downstream targets of the axis Src-Raf-MEK-ERK, rather than upstream regulators.
justification: The reverse arrow to PMC4242838 in the same batch, and the paper's whole point is that the direction has been assumed the wrong way round. Recording both lets the map show a loop and lets a reader see which direction each experiment actually tested.

mechanism: co-immunoprecipitation of endogenous proteins from mouse cortical neurons, with confocal co-localization; store depletion by thapsigargin increased STIM1-NR2A co-localization by 22% while abolishing STIM1-NR2B, and STIM1 arriving at the membrane displaces STIM2 from NR2A
sentence: These experiments uncovered the physical interaction between endogenous STIM1 or STIM2 with the NMDAR2 subunits, NR2A and NR2B.
justification: GRIN2A and GRIN2B are the curator's rows, and the NMDA receptor is the second big Ca2+ entry route in neurons. The subunits are named, the proteins are endogenous, and the contact is store-dependent - so this is a junction between the two entry systems, not a co-localization artefact.

mechanism: same co-immunoprecipitations; binding between NR2B and STIM1 *decreases* after thapsigargin, the opposite of NR2A
sentence: These experiments uncovered the physical interaction between endogenous STIM1 or STIM2 with the NMDAR2 subunits, NR2A and NR2B.
justification: The two NR2 subunits respond to store depletion in opposite directions, which is another reason the map keeps subunits apart.

mechanism: same co-immunoprecipitations; NR2A-STIM2 is the strongest co-localization of the four pairs at rest and is lost after store depletion as STIM1 takes its place
sentence: These experiments uncovered the physical interaction between endogenous STIM1 or STIM2 with the NMDAR2 subunits, NR2A and NR2B.
justification: A competition between the two sensors for the same receptor subunit, which is a mechanism the map has nowhere else.

mechanism: same co-immunoprecipitations; the STIM2-NR2B association does not change after store depletion
sentence: These experiments uncovered the physical interaction between endogenous STIM1 or STIM2 with the NMDAR2 subunits, NR2A and NR2B.
justification: The fourth pair, recorded so the reader can see which three of the four move with store state and which does not.

mechanism: overexpressing STIM1 cut the NMDA-evoked cytosolic Ca2+ rise by 50% (STIM2 by 30%), and cortical neurons from STIM1-overexpressing mice responded 35% less; knocking either sensor down enhanced the NMDA response. The functional measurement is whole-cell NMDA-evoked Ca2+ and does not resolve the subunit - the subunit assignment comes from the co-immunoprecipitation in the same paper
sentence: Our data suggest that STIM1 and STIM2 are negative regulators of NMDA-evoked intracellular Ca2+ elevations in cortical neurons, as is known for VGCC activity.
justification: STIM1 restraining another Ca2+ channel, as it does for CACNA1C and CACNA1S. The pattern is now broad enough to be a property of the sensor rather than a curiosity of one channel.

mechanism: same overexpression and knockdown series, with STIM2 giving a 30% reduction against STIM1's 50%; same caveat on subunit resolution
sentence: Our data suggest that STIM1 and STIM2 are negative regulators of NMDA-evoked intracellular Ca2+ elevations in cortical neurons, as is known for VGCC activity.
justification: Both sensors act the same way here, which is worth recording because elsewhere in the map (SERCA1a, PERK) they act in opposite directions.

mechanism: vasopressin raised ORAI1 and STIM1 transcripts and store-operated entry in human aortic smooth muscle cells, together with the osteogenic transcripts CBFA1, MSX2, SOX9 and ALPL and Ca2+ deposition; both the ORAI1 blocker MRS1845 and the SGK1 inhibitor GSK-650394 abolished the effects
sentence: In conclusion, vasopressin stimulates expression of ORAI1/STIM1, thus augmenting store-operated Ca2+ entry and osteogenic signalling.
justification: A second hormone upstream of anchor abundance after klotho and leptin, and the only one so far whose output is vascular calcification - a phenotype where calcium is both the signal and the pathology.

mechanism: same experiment; both transcripts rise together
sentence: In conclusion, vasopressin stimulates expression of ORAI1/STIM1, thus augmenting store-operated Ca2+ entry and osteogenic signalling.
justification: The sensor side of the vasopressin input.

mechanism: the ORAI1 blocker MRS1845 abolished the vasopressin-induced rise in CBFA1 (RUNX2) transcript as well as the rise in store-operated entry; the SGK1 inhibitor did the same, placing SGK1 and the channel on the same path
sentence: The effect of vasopressin on store-operated Ca2+ entry as well as on transcript levels of CBFA1, MSX2, SOX9 and ALPL was virtually abrogated by MRS1845 and GSK-650394.
justification: The master osteogenic transcription factor downstream of ORAI1. Together with MSX2, SOX9 and ALPL it gives the map a whole transcriptional programme under the channel, which is more informative than any single effector.

mechanism: same blocker experiment
sentence: The effect of vasopressin on store-operated Ca2+ entry as well as on transcript levels of CBFA1, MSX2, SOX9 and ALPL was virtually abrogated by MRS1845 and GSK-650394.
justification: Second member of the osteogenic programme under ORAI1.

mechanism: same blocker experiment
sentence: The effect of vasopressin on store-operated Ca2+ entry as well as on transcript levels of CBFA1, MSX2, SOX9 and ALPL was virtually abrogated by MRS1845 and GSK-650394.
justification: Third member of the programme, and a transcription factor the calcium field rarely connects to SOCE.

mechanism: same blocker experiment; ALPL degrades pyrophosphate, the endogenous inhibitor of calcification, so this is the enzymatic end of the arm
sentence: The effect of vasopressin on store-operated Ca2+ entry as well as on transcript levels of CBFA1, MSX2, SOX9 and ALPL was virtually abrogated by MRS1845 and GSK-650394.
justification: The step that actually produces mineral deposition, and the clearest reason the arm matters clinically.

mechanism: stable STIM1 or ORAI1 knock-down in ML-1 follicular thyroid cancer cells lowered SOCE, basal and sphingosine-1-phosphate-evoked invasion, and the protein levels of VEGFR2; the S1P receptors fell too, but the paper does not say which of the five
sentence: Knock-down of STIM1 or ORAI1 attenuated SOCE, reduced invasion, and the expression of promigratory sphingosine 1-phosphate and vascular endothelial growth factor-2 receptors in thyroid cancer ML-1 cells.
justification: A receptor tyrosine kinase whose abundance depends on the anchors, in a tumour type the map does not otherwise reach. The S1P receptor from the same sentence is left out for want of an isoform.

mechanism: same knock-down series
sentence: Knock-down of STIM1 or ORAI1 attenuated SOCE, reduced invasion, and the expression of promigratory sphingosine 1-phosphate and vascular endothelial growth factor-2 receptors in thyroid cancer ML-1 cells.
justification: The channel side of the VEGFR2 edge.

mechanism: STIM1 knock-down reinstated thyroid-stimulating hormone receptor and the thyroid-specific proteins (thyroglobulin, thyroperoxidase, Na-I symporter) and increased iodine uptake, so the sensor keeps the differentiated programme switched off in this cancer line
sentence: Furthermore, we show that STIM1-KD increases the susceptibility of thyroid cancer ML-1 cells to drugs used for treatment of thyroid cancer, reinstates the expression of thyroid stimulating hormone receptor (TSHR), thyroid specific proteins and increased iodine uptake.
justification: Flagged `beyond_calcium`: thyroid differentiation is the biological end of the arm and has nothing calcium about it, which is exactly what the flag was introduced for. Clinically it is the most consequential claim in the paper - losing STIM1 makes the tumour take up iodine again, which is what radioiodine therapy needs.

mechanism: STIM1 and ORAI1 knock-down cells proliferate less, with a longer G1 phase, lower cdk6 and higher p21 and p27
sentence: Cell proliferation was attenuated in these knock-down cells due to increased G1 phase of the cell cycle and enhanced expression of cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitory proteins p21 and p27.
justification: The cell-cycle brake the anchors hold down. Flagged `beyond_calcium` for the same reason as TSHR; p27 and cdk6 from the same sentence are left out to avoid padding the map with one experiment's whole western blot.

mechanism: neurons from patients with chorea-acanthocytosis, caused by loss-of-function mutations in the chorein gene VPS13A, have less ORAI1 and STIM1/2 transcript and protein, blunted SOCE and more suicidal death; lithium restores expression, SOCE and the CRAC current, and the NF-kappaB inhibitor wogonin abolishes that restoration
sentence: BACKGROUND/AIMS: The neurodegenerative disease Chorea-Acanthocytosis (ChAc) is caused by loss-of-function-mutations of the chorein-encoding gene VPS13A. In ChAc neurons transcript levels and protein abundance of Ca2+ release activated channel moiety (CRAC) Orai1 as well as its regulator STIM1/2 are decreased, resulting in blunted store operated Ca2+-entry (SOCE) and enhanced suicidal cell death.
justification: A human disease gene whose loss lowers both anchors, in patient-derived neurons, with a drug (lithium) that reverses it through NF-kappaB - the same transcription factor the SGK1 and klotho records of batch 15 run through. Two sentences are quoted because the gene and the phenotype are named in different ones.

mechanism: same patient-derived neurons; STIM1/2 fall with ORAI1 and are restored by lithium in a wogonin-sensitive way
sentence: BACKGROUND/AIMS: The neurodegenerative disease Chorea-Acanthocytosis (ChAc) is caused by loss-of-function-mutations of the chorein-encoding gene VPS13A. In ChAc neurons transcript levels and protein abundance of Ca2+ release activated channel moiety (CRAC) Orai1 as well as its regulator STIM1/2 are decreased, resulting in blunted store operated Ca2+-entry (SOCE) and enhanced suicidal cell death.
justification: The sensor side of the chorein arm; this is a loss-of-SOCE neurodegeneration, the opposite polarity to the Huntington's records in this batch, where the problem is too much release.

mechanism: urotensin-II, the most potent endogenous vasoconstrictor known, acts through UTS2R; knocking down STIM1 or Orai1 in transfected rat coronary artery abolished UII-evoked SOCE and the contraction, while leaving high-KCl contraction intact
sentence: In addition, knockdown of either STIM1 or Orai1 essentially inhibited UII-mediated SOCE and prevented UII but not high-KCL evoked contraction in transfected coronary artery.
justification: A vasoactive peptide reaching the anchors, with vessel contraction as the read-out and a specificity control (KCl) showing the anchors are not needed for depolarization-driven contraction.

mechanism: same knockdown experiments in intact artery
sentence: In addition, knockdown of either STIM1 or Orai1 essentially inhibited UII-mediated SOCE and prevented UII but not high-KCL evoked contraction in transfected coronary artery.
justification: The sensor side of the urotensin input.

mechanism: iPLA2beta was involved in the urotensin-II response and co-localized with STIM1 in submembrane compartments; STIM1 but not Orai1 downregulation blocked its activation, and lysophosphatidylcholine - an iPLA2 product - then activated contraction and SOCE through Orai1 but not STIM1
sentence: Importantly, STIM1 but not Orai1 downregulation inhibits significantly independent phospholipase A(2) activation.
justification: The reverse arrow to PLA2G6 -> ORAI1 recorded in batch 15 (PMID 22549787), and the asymmetry is the interesting part: the sensor activates the lipase, the lipase's product acts on the channel. A loop with a different protein at each step, not a contradiction.

mechanism: megakaryocytes express collagen VI; in Col6a1-/- mice both megakaryocytes and platelets have more STIM1 and ORAI1, more mTOR signalling and platelets more prone to activation, and patients with Bethlem myopathy and Ullrich congenital muscular dystrophy show the same rise
sentence: Col6a1-/- megakaryocytes and platelets showed increased expression of stromal interaction molecule 1 (STIM1) and ORAI1, the components of store-operated calcium entry (SOCE), and activation of the mammalian target of rapamycin (mTOR) signaling pathway.
justification: An extracellular matrix protein setting the abundance of the anchors inside the cell, confirmed in patients with two named collagen VI diseases. It is the first matrix component in the map's upstream set.

mechanism: same knock-out and the same patient platelets
sentence: Col6a1-/- megakaryocytes and platelets showed increased expression of stromal interaction molecule 1 (STIM1) and ORAI1, the components of store-operated calcium entry (SOCE), and activation of the mammalian target of rapamycin (mTOR) signaling pathway.
justification: The channel side of the collagen VI arm.

mechanism: rapamycin given in vivo lowered STIM1 and ORAI1 expression and calcium flows in Col6a1-/- platelets and normalized their susceptibility to activation, so mTOR is the step between the matrix defect and the anchors
sentence: In vivo mTOR inhibition by rapamycin reduced STIM1 and ORAI1 expression and calcium flows, resulting in a normalization of platelet susceptibility to activation.
justification: Batch 13 recorded STIM1 -> MTOR activation (PMID 25917875); this is the return arrow, mTOR setting how much STIM1 there is. A feedback loop with a whole-animal intervention on one side.

mechanism: same rapamycin experiment
sentence: In vivo mTOR inhibition by rapamycin reduced STIM1 and ORAI1 expression and calcium flows, resulting in a normalization of platelet susceptibility to activation.
justification: The channel side of the mTOR arm, and the pharmacological handle: an approved drug lowers ORAI1 abundance in vivo.

mechanism: Stim1/Stim2 double deletion in NOTCH1-driven leukaemic cells abolished SOCE, prolonged survival, prevented bone marrow necrosis and anaemia, and lowered chemokines and CSF1, IL-16 and IL-34 - consistent with fewer tumour-associated macrophages. The deletion is combined, so the two sensors are not separated by experiment
sentence: Collectively, the reduced expression of chemokines and of IL-16, IL-34, and CSF1 is consistent with the decreased numbers of F4/80+ Cd11b+ macrophages in theBMof mice with Stim1/2-/- leukemia and an important proinflammatory role of SOCE in leukemic cells via the recruitment and activation of TAMs into leukemia-infiltrated tissues.
justification: A macrophage-recruiting cytokine under the sensors, with survival of the animal as the read-out. It also connects the map to NOTCH1, which batch 15 placed above the ORAI family from the other direction.

mechanism: same combined deletion
sentence: Collectively, the reduced expression of chemokines and of IL-16, IL-34, and CSF1 is consistent with the decreased numbers of F4/80+ Cd11b+ macrophages in theBMof mice with Stim1/2-/- leukemia and an important proinflammatory role of SOCE in leukemic cells via the recruitment and activation of TAMs into leukemia-infiltrated tissues.
justification: Recorded beside STIM1 because the experiment deleted both and cannot tell them apart; saying so in the mechanism is better than silently crediting one.

mechanism: same expression profiling of leukaemic cells from the bone marrow on day 21
sentence: Collectively, the reduced expression of chemokines and of IL-16, IL-34, and CSF1 is consistent with the decreased numbers of F4/80+ Cd11b+ macrophages in theBMof mice with Stim1/2-/- leukemia and an important proinflammatory role of SOCE in leukemic cells via the recruitment and activation of TAMs into leukemia-infiltrated tissues.
justification: IL-34 is the second ligand of the CSF1 receptor, so the two edges together say the leukaemic cell recruits macrophages through both.

mechanism: same combined deletion
sentence: Collectively, the reduced expression of chemokines and of IL-16, IL-34, and CSF1 is consistent with the decreased numbers of F4/80+ Cd11b+ macrophages in theBMof mice with Stim1/2-/- leukemia and an important proinflammatory role of SOCE in leukemic cells via the recruitment and activation of TAMs into leukemia-infiltrated tissues.
justification: The STIM2 half of the IL-34 edge.

mechanism: a high-concentrate diet in sheep raised STIM1 and ORAI1 and mammary Ca2+ content; the authors place CaMKKbeta between the Ca2+ rise and NF-kappaB, with p-IkappaB, p-p65 and the cytokines IL-6, IL-8, IL-1beta and TNF-alpha all up. This is in vivo co-regulation, not a loss-of-function experiment
sentence: In summary, SARA disrupts Ca2+ homeostasis via STIM1/ORAI1 upregulation, triggering a cascade of inflammation, autophagy, and apoptosis in Hu sheep mammary glands through the CaMKKbeta-mediated NF-kappaB and AMPK-mTOR pathways.
justification: CaMKKbeta is the missing middle of an arm the map already half holds: batch 12 recorded STIM1 -> PRKAA1 activation (PMID 25242372) *through CaMKKbeta*, and the kinase itself had no node. Now it does, and the AMPK arm has its intermediate.

mechanism: same in vivo correlation, with the same caveat
sentence: In summary, SARA disrupts Ca2+ homeostasis via STIM1/ORAI1 upregulation, triggering a cascade of inflammation, autophagy, and apoptosis in Hu sheep mammary glands through the CaMKKbeta-mediated NF-kappaB and AMPK-mTOR pathways.
justification: The channel side of the CaMKKbeta edge.

mechanism: co-immunoprecipitation showing an enhanced ORAI1-p65 interaction in high-concentrate-fed sheep mammary tissue, alongside raised p-IkappaB and p-p65
sentence: Elevated Ca2+ activated the CaMKKbeta-NF-kappaB pathway, as evidenced by increased p-IkappaB, p-p65, upregulation of pro-inflammatory cytokines (IL-6, IL-8, IL-1beta, TNF-alpha) in mammary gland tissues, and enhanced interaction between ORAI1 and p65.
justification: A channel binding a transcription factor directly, which would be a strong claim if confirmed - and it is the only named-subunit physical link between an anchor and NF-kappaB the map has seen. Recorded with its weakness stated: one co-immunoprecipitation in tissue, no reciprocal pull-down.

mechanism: cisplatin raised COX2, IL-8 and TNF-alpha transcripts and COX2 protein in cisplatin-resistant MDA-MB-231 cells, and co-treatment with the SOCE blocker BTP2 reversed it; BTP2 alone changed nothing, and the attribution to ORAI1 follows the drug's target rather than a knockdown
sentence: Finally, this study also demonstrated that cisplatin therapy caused an increase in the gene expression of inflammatory mediators COX2, IL-8, and TNF-alpha as well as COX2 protein and upon SOCE inhibition using BTP2, the effect of cisplatin on the inflammatory mediators was reversed.
justification: PTGS2 is one of the curator's rows and had no literature edge from an anchor. The context is useful too: the inflammatory response to chemotherapy runs through SOCE, which is a therapeutic argument rather than a correlation.

mechanism: same cisplatin and BTP2 experiment
sentence: Finally, this study also demonstrated that cisplatin therapy caused an increase in the gene expression of inflammatory mediators COX2, IL-8, and TNF-alpha as well as COX2 protein and upon SOCE inhibition using BTP2, the effect of cisplatin on the inflammatory mediators was reversed.
justification: A third independent paper on ORAI1 -> IL8, after the cystic fibrosis epithelium (batch 13) and histamine-stimulated endothelium (batch 14). Three tissues, three stimuli, one cytokine.

mechanism: same cisplatin and BTP2 experiment
sentence: Finally, this study also demonstrated that cisplatin therapy caused an increase in the gene expression of inflammatory mediators COX2, IL-8, and TNF-alpha as well as COX2 protein and upon SOCE inhibition using BTP2, the effect of cisplatin on the inflammatory mediators was reversed.
justification: TNF is one of the curator's rows; this is one of three papers in this batch putting it under the anchors, in three different tissues.

mechanism: Loureirin B inhibited the STIM1/Orai1 current in HEK293T cells with an IC50 of 17 microM and lowered Ca2+ influx and IL-2 secretion in Jurkat T cells, including in KV1.3 knock-out cells where the potassium channel can no longer contribute
sentence: Our results suggest that Loureirin B inhibits Ca2+ influx and IL-2 secretion in Jurkat T cells by inhibiting both KV1.3 and STIM1/Orai1 channels.
justification: The canonical T cell output of SOCE, which the map did not yet carry: in batch 14 IL2 appeared under CRACR2A and was two hops from an anchor, so it was dropped. Here it is one hop.

mechanism: same pharmacology, with the KV1.3 knock-out as the control that isolates the STIM1/Orai1 contribution
sentence: Our results suggest that Loureirin B inhibits Ca2+ influx and IL-2 secretion in Jurkat T cells by inhibiting both KV1.3 and STIM1/Orai1 channels.
justification: The channel side of the IL2 edge.

mechanism: silencing ORAI3, but not ORAI1, reduced the hypoxia-induced rise in EGFR phosphorylation in MDA-MB-468 cells without changing total EGFR; ORAI3 is itself induced by hypoxia, yet silencing it does not affect HIF1alpha induction, so the regulation is not reciprocal
sentence: ORAI3 but not ORAI1 silencing significantly reduced hypoxia-induced increases in EGFR phosphorylation, although ORAI1 silencing was close to significance (p value of 0.0546) (Figure 4C).
justification: A job that belongs to ORAI3 and not to ORAI1, tested side by side. It also sits against the ORAI1 -> HIF1A edge recorded in batch 15: the two paralogues relate to the hypoxia pathway in different directions, which is an argument for keeping them separate rather than as "ORAI channels".

mechanism: knockdown and overexpression of STIM2, but not STIM1, changed NFAT1 transcript and protein and its nuclear translocation in MDA-MB-231 and MCF7 cells; NFAT1 then occupies the TGF-beta1 promoter and raises TGF-beta1 expression and secretion, driving EMT and metastasis
sentence: However, STIM2 promotes breast cancer metastasis via regulating the expression of the transcription factor nuclear factor of activated T cells 1 (NFAT1) and its translocation to the TGF-beta1 promoter, leading to upregulated expression and secretion of TGF-beta1.
justification: "NFAT" has been on the blocked list since batch 6; this paper names NFAT1, which is NFATC2, so a level-2 seed of the curator's effector module gets its first literature edge. The claim is also specific to STIM2, with STIM1 as the internal negative control.

mechanism: CRISPR/Cas9 knock-out of STIM1 or STIM2 in Jurkat T-cells reduced nuclear translocation of native NFAT1 after thapsigargin or anti-CD3, with STIM1 KO slightly more effective; the double knock-out abolished it entirely, along with Ca2+ oscillations and ER store content
sentence: We discovered significantly reduced nuclear translocation of NFAT1 in STIM1 KO and STIM2 KO cells in response to both thapsigargin and alpha-CD3 stimulation, with STIM1 KO cells showing slightly more inhibition of NFAT1 nuclear translocation (Fig. 6).
justification: The second paper in this batch to name NFAT1, and the one that connects it to an anchor rather than to STIM2 - which is what admits NFATC2 to the map at all under the one-hop rule. Genetic knock-outs, two stimuli, and a double knock-out that removes the response completely.

mechanism: same knock-out panel; STIM2 KO alone reduces NFAT1 translocation, and the authors describe STIM2 as an amplifier that recruits STIM1 to ER-PM junctions
sentence: We discovered significantly reduced nuclear translocation of NFAT1 in STIM1 KO and STIM2 KO cells in response to both thapsigargin and alpha-CD3 stimulation, with STIM1 KO cells showing slightly more inhibition of NFAT1 nuclear translocation (Fig. 6).
justification: Independent support, in T cells and by knock-out, for the STIM2 -> NFATC2 edge that PMC6716836 established in breast cancer by knockdown and overexpression.

mechanism: in cultured mouse spinal astrocytes, thapsigargin and cyclopiazonic acid drove TNF-alpha and IL-6 release; YM-58483, 2-APB and knockdown of STIM2 or Orai1 blocked the LPS-induced production, while STIM1 knockdown did not - so the two sensors serve different stimuli in the same cell
sentence: Importantly, SOCE can induce TNF-alpha and IL-6 production, and STIM2 and Orai1 play an important role in lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced cytokine production from spinal astrocytes.
justification: A stimulus-specific split between STIM1 and STIM2 inside one cell type, which is the cleanest argument in the map for not treating them as interchangeable. The tissue matters too: astrocyte cytokines are the central-sensitization arm of pain.

mechanism: same knockdown series; LPS-induced IL-6 needs STIM2 and Orai1 but not STIM1
sentence: Importantly, SOCE can induce TNF-alpha and IL-6 production, and STIM2 and Orai1 play an important role in lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced cytokine production from spinal astrocytes.
justification: IL6 is one of the curator's rows; this is its first literature edge from the SOCE side.

mechanism: same experiments; Orai1 knockdown blocks cytokine production after both store depletion and LPS
sentence: Importantly, SOCE can induce TNF-alpha and IL-6 production, and STIM2 and Orai1 play an important role in lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced cytokine production from spinal astrocytes.
justification: The channel is required for both stimuli, unlike the sensors - a second, independent ORAI1 -> TNF edge beside the breast cancer one in this batch.

mechanism: same experiments
sentence: Importantly, SOCE can induce TNF-alpha and IL-6 production, and STIM2 and Orai1 play an important role in lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced cytokine production from spinal astrocytes.
justification: The channel side of the IL6 edge.

mechanism: with store depletion rather than LPS as the stimulus, STIM1 knockdown does reduce TNF-alpha and IL-6 release; neither knockdown affected the loss of cell viability, so the cytokine arm is separable from the toxicity
sentence: In addition, activation of SOCCs remarkably promoted TNF-alpha and IL-6 production in spinal astrocytes, which were greatly attenuated by knockdown of STIM1 or Orai1.
justification: Recorded alongside the LPS result to keep the stimulus-dependence visible: STIM1 matters for store depletion and not for LPS, in the same cells, in the same paper.

mechanism: genome-wide chromatin immunoprecipitation and sequencing in mouse identified NEUROD2 binding an intronic element within intron 2 of the Stim1 gene, and NEUROD2 limits Stim1 expression in cortical neurons - the authors note this is the opposite of NEUROD2's usual activator role
sentence: We show that NEUROD2 limits Stim1 expression in cortical neurons and consequently fine-tunes the SOCE response upon depletion of ER calcium.
justification: Chased from a passing mention in PMC7813759. A neurogenic transcription factor binding the STIM1 gene itself, with ChIP-seq rather than a correlation - the map's only direct transcriptional regulator of STIM1 with a mapped binding site.
